LIVE CONNECTION

Connect to the student app’s Supabase project

The student app’s project URL and publishable key are prefilled. Existing student and admin Auth accounts work here without being copied. These are client-side values; never enter a service-role secret. For live Supabase mode, serve this file from an http(s) site; some browsers block API requests from file:// URLs.

Database setup SQL (copy into Supabase SQL Editor)

Fresh setup installs both subject banks, admin-only per-student Science/SST assignment, and the shared daily target/set flow. If setup already succeeded, do not rerun it; use the complete idempotent existing-install update below. It preserves existing Auth accounts, profiles, and progress. The browser cannot safely execute schema changes; use the existing student app project’s SQL Editor.

Admin set assignment update SQL (for existing setup)

This idempotent migration adds the P3–P7 SST question-only bank, lets the admin assign Science or SST per student, and makes each subject use the same daily target/set flow (20 by default). SST starts at P3 Q1 and continues through P7 Q2040. Existing assignments/progress and Auth/profile rows are preserved; an active set finishes in its original subject. Use this migration for an existing setup; do not rerun the full setup or authorization SQL.

Auth uses the existing SmartPle project; Q-A profile/class data is synchronized from smartple_profiles. Admin access also requires the owner-managed daily_qa_admins allowlist.

Q&A ACCOUNT

Sign in

Sign in with the same student or administrator account you use in the student app.

Student and admin passwords are handled by Supabase Auth; the built-in Admin Preview assigns each student Science or SST and manages daily targets and progress.

ADMIN CONTROL

Daily revision plans

Choose Science or SST for each student, set the daily target (20 by default), inspect progress, and assign a repeat or next-unused set.

Students

Select a student to assign Science or SST and manage their daily set.
